The original pedal has not gained popularity in the DIY/boutique community due to the lack of accurate schematics. However, those who have played the original can attest to its excellent sound quality. The standout feature of the Parametric Overdrive is its parametric tone control, which allows for a wide range of frequency adjustment from 100Hz to 4kHz. This pedal is known for its transparency and ability to retain low frequencies. The Parametric Overdrive includes a true bypass and a Q mod, which adjusts the Q of the parametric EQ. The PCB also has extra spaces for modifications to the OD section, allowing for customization to achieve different overdrive sounds. The suggested modifications include adding film capacitors to tighten up the low end, increasing gain and low end with resistors and film capacitors, reducing minimum gain setting with a resistor, and using asymmetrical clipping diodes for different crunchiness levels. For more information on modifications, the instructions provide additional details.
